verdict.rationale: A DGX B300 system exposes programmatic interfaces, including BMC Redfish/IPMI management and the CUDA, NIM and NeMo software stack, so asking about API versioning and deprecation is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack, however, documents no API versioning scheme or deprecation policy. The Redfish/IPMI mention only lists management interfaces, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
